name: Lust Academy - Season 1
source:
You play as a normal 18 years old guy whos life is about to change forever! You’ll find out about the whole world full of magic and adventure that awaits you at Cordale - the oldest academy of magic and wizardry in the New World. The most important thing: don’t forget to get to know other students and teachers! We’re sure you’ll find most of them… charming!

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你扮演一个普通的18岁男孩，他的生活即将永远改变！你会发现整个充满魔法和冒险的世界在科代尔等待着你——新世界最古老的魔法和巫师学院。最重要的是：不要忘记结识其他学生和老师！我们相信你会发现其中的大多数……都很迷人！

[来自F95Zone]
